title: Open restricted composition respects the specified derived pullback counit
statement: For any scheme map g′:X′→X, open U⊂X, complex P and derived categories on all schemes, let p,q be the projections of T=X′×X U, Q=restrict(U.ι)(P), and Pg=tensorPullback(g′)(P) [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Let eQ=openRestrictionRepresentativeIso(U.ι,P) [def-pc-open-derived-stalk-iso], beta=openRestrictedCompositionMap(g′,U,DQ(P)) [def-pc-open-restricted-composition-map], d=openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso(g′,U,P) [def-pc-open-restricted-tensor-complex-iso] and epsilon_g,epsilon_q the specified counits [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Then Lq*(eQ.hom);beta;Lp*(epsilon_g(P)) = epsilon_q(Q);d.inv. This is an equation of derived morphisms, with no stalk or cohomology, no base-change square to S and no K-flatness or invertibility assumption.

proof.text: Evaluate the defining leftDerivedLift factorization equations for the specified composition comparisons for (q,U.ι) and (p,g′), and identify the direct pullback by pullback.condition.

Use the leftDerivedUnique factorization for exact open restriction and counit naturality to replace the tensor pullbacks along U.ι and p with the literal restrictions and their constructed representative factors. The remaining termwise tensor-composition factors are exactly the constructed d. Cancel isomorphisms to obtain the equation.

lean.statement:
theorem openRestricted_counit_compatibility
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let Q := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).map (openRestrictionRepresentativeIso U.ι P).hom ≫
        openRestrictedCompositionMap g' U (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).map
          ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)) =
      (counit (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
        (openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso g' U P).inv
